subject: Raise the Age Legislation and Open Meeting Training
overview: The Commission heard a presentation on legislation to raise the age of juvenile jurisdiction and received legal training on the Massachusetts Open Meeting Law. The body also approved a request to amend a previous vote regarding a ceasefire resolution.

items.title: Amendment of Prior Vote
items.summary: Approved a motion from Chief Buckley to amend his vote on the Medford City Council's ceasefire resolution from 'yes' to 'abstain' to maintain professional neutrality.

items.title: Raise the Age Legislation Presentation
items.summary: Sana Fadel of Citizens for Juvenile Justice presented on proposed state legislation that would move 18-to-20-year-olds into the juvenile justice system to improve recidivism outcomes and developmental support.

items.title: Minutes and Scribe Appointments
items.summary: Approved the February 2024 meeting minutes and designated a volunteer to record minutes for the April meeting.

items.title: Calendar and Event Planning
items.summary: Postponed the Belinda Sutton commemoration event and discussed aligning future commission activities with city-wide Juneteenth and Black Health series programming.

items.title: Pride Month Involvement
items.summary: Discussed the commission's role in upcoming Pride flag-raising ceremonies and expressed interest in developing a more substantial independent event for 2025.

items.title: Open Meeting Law Training
items.summary: Attorney Janelle Austin reviewed the state's Open Meeting Law, highlighting regulations regarding serial communication via email, the formation of subcommittees, and the use of collaborative technology like Google Docs.
